title: Build bounded English grammar tests and vocabulary recall activities

audience.curriculum: England; illustrative secondary study, not a confirmed school assignment
audience.level: Ages 12–14 starting example; school year and exam scope must be configured

objectives.description: Choose is/are to agree with the grammatical subject in the reviewed sentence bank.
Recall a listed scientific term for the supplied sense and context; do not infer spelling, production or science mastery.

contentRequirements: Explain agreement using head nouns and contrasting reviewed examples; preserve standard-written-English scope.
Provide three sense records and six reviewed prompts exactly as supplied; preserve IDs and distinguish definition/context prompts.
Describe one-mark binary rubrics agreement and recall-term, variant normalisation and unsupported cases.
Keep expansion suggestions separate from exam lists; explain that this finite bank does not establish broad transfer.

generation.parameterDomain: Six supplied subject IDs multiplied by two predicate IDs = 12 sentences.
generation.algorithm: Select compatible subject/predicate entries with a versioned seeded PRNG; preserve exact text and private head/number metadata.
constraints: Use only the supplied bank and is/are alternatives; no invented sentence fragments.
Return unavailable for unsupported tense/register/structure or scope.
Keep subject head and correct form private until authorised help/feedback.
difficultyDimensions: Matching versus conflicting number of nearby nouns

assessment.responseContract: JSON string containing is or are after trimming and ASCII case folding. Other words or full sentences are unassessed.
assessment.checkerStrategy: Use reviewed subject number to select the required form; never use the nearest noun heuristic.
rules: One binary criterion agreement, one mark.
Supported alternative is/are with wrong agreement is incorrect; malformed or unsupported input is unassessed.
Do not award production or general grammar mastery from cloze alone.

cases.reason: Head box is singular despite nearby plural pencils.
Head key is singular, not books.
Head keys is plural despite nearby singular book.

cases.response: The lamp is near the window.
cases.reason: This response contract requests only the missing word.
Only is/are is supported; prompt for the requested format.

interactionRequirements: Learn mode can reveal the head and explain why nearby nouns do not control agreement; record help.
In mock mode show the same sentence with a blank and unranked is/are choices; no grammatical highlighting or live feedback.
Use native text initially; advanced token editing requires a declared custom view, never an invented native scene.
families.transferRequirement: Hold back different subject/predicate combinations and retain structure IDs. Label exhausted/reused variants. Broader editing and writing transfer require another validated family.

generation.parameterDomain: Three supplied sense IDs multiplied by two context IDs d/c = six prompts.
generation.algorithm: Choose a sense/context pair from the frozen approved list using a seeded PRNG; prepend the exact recall instruction. The independent prompt does not display the answer list.
constraints: Only supplied senses and reviewed prompts; generated extra words never enter exam scope.
No runtime synonym invention or unrestricted definition grading.
Keep sense ID and expected term in private state: student-facing state exposes only the recall instruction and context prompt; hide the word list during independent recall.

assessment.responseContract: JSON string from mass, volume, density after trimming and ASCII case folding. Other text is unassessed.
assessment.checkerStrategy: Match the supported listed response to the private reviewed sense key; preserve separate objective/sense/context evidence.
rules: One binary criterion recall-term, one mark.
Another listed term is incorrect; other text is unassessed for this bounded task.
No spelling, productive-use or science-calculation evidence is awarded by this family.

cases.reason: Correct supplied term for mass divided by volume.
Mass is a supported listed response but the requested quantity is density.
Whitespace/case normalisation; occupied space in cm³ is volume.
The supplied quantity expressed in grams is mass.
Prompt explicitly asks for a listed term; do not classify unsupported wording as a misconception.
Request a response; no demonstrated wrong concept.

interactionRequirements: Learn mode can reveal the definition and other context; record assistance.
Learn mode may show the three-word list. In diagnostic/practice/review/mock independent attempts hide it; any authorised reveal outside mock mode counts as help. Mock mode blocks list reveals.
Use typed answers for this reference; later confirmed voice recall must not be treated as spelling evidence.
families.transferRequirement: Use a held-back context if available and label repeats. Productive vocabulary requires an independently assessed new context; any optional expansion remains outside the active exam.

requirements.statement: Every objective, explanation and rule resolves to the approved source.
requirements.verification: Verify source digests/anchors, objective/dependency closure and semantic support.

requirements.statement: Packages follow the supplied v1 contract and operate offline.
requirements.verification: Validate manifests, local schemas, runtime exports, reproducibility and all available host gates; report unavailable host checks pending.

requirements.statement: Help and private answer fields cannot leak into a mock exam.
requirements.verification: Check public state, rendered content, actions and voice controls in each mode.

requirements.statement: Follow help with an independent item and retain family/context identity.
requirements.verification: Exercise the host journey when available; verify reuse labels, assistance tracking and scope boundaries.

requirements.statement: All 12 sentence combinations preserve grammatical meaning and unique agreement.
requirements.verification: Exhaust the bank; compare accepted forms to independently reviewed source keys; run supplied edge cases.

requirements.statement: All six sense/context prompts have a unique answer within the explicit list.
requirements.verification: Review every prompt and wrong listed alternative; retain stable sense/context identities in fixtures and host evidence.

requirements.statement: The host recognises reused prompts and distinguishes recall from productive vocabulary.
requirements.verification: Verify stable family/structural metadata, exhaustion behaviour and separate evidence categories; mark host checks pending until implemented.

nonGoals: Full grammar coverage, unrestricted writing or automatic essay grading
A general synonym checker or spelling/pronunciation assessment
Automatic promotion of expansion words into an exam
Changing the scientific curriculum from vocabulary recognition alone
deliveryRequirements: Content and dynamic packages with exact source and dependency bindings
Bundled runtime, TypeScript source and reproducible build metadata
Manifest-bound reports with evidence or pending status for every requirement
No learner records, provider credentials, undeclared dependencies or install scripts
Use the supplied science/language design rules; do not invent scene kinds or claim unimplemented host tests passed.
